title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
In the upcoming CBB game between Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks and Abilene Christian Wildcats, originally scheduled for Wednesday, November 11, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET (as of creation of the first market related to the event):
If the Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks win, the market will resolve to "Stephen F. Austin Lumberjacks".
If the Abilene Christian Wildcats win, the market will resolve to "Abilene Christian Wildcats".
If this market's outcome was definitively determined under its rules by the listed resolution sources before abandonment, that outcome will stand. Otherwise, the following no-result provisions apply. If the game is canceled, does not start by Friday, November 13, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or is abandoned with no official result by that time, this market will resolve 50-50.
The result will be determined based on the final score including any overtime periods.
